resources.string: Shows a floating microphone button while another keyboard is open. Tap it to dictate with Parakeetype; the text is inserted into the focused field. Parakeetype uses this access only to find the focused text field, to see whether a keyboard is shown and to insert the transcript. Speech is processed on this device and nothing is sent anywhere.
Could not insert the text, so it was copied to the clipboard
A microphone bubble appears while you type with another keyboard

Optional: turn on "Parakeetype dictation bubble" under Accessibility to dictate while using your normal keyboard. If the switch is greyed out, allow restricted settings in Parakeetype\'s app info first.
